data.exact_reserve_text: The claims ratio worsened due to the variability of prior year claims releases year on year. In 2023 there were claims releases across the syndicate's book. In 2024 while the Property Risks experienced prior year reserve releases, the cyber book demonstrated reserve strengthening, arising from adverse development on older year risks.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on older year cyber risks
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on older year risks resulted in reserve strengthening in the cyber portfolio.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 gross claims outstanding were $113.609m. During 2024 there was a net favourable movement in prior year estimates of $4.367m (a release, c.3.8% of opening reserves) driven by prior year releases in the Property book offset by adverse development in the Cyber portfolio which led to reserve strengthening on older years.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Source figures were presented in the report as $'000 and have been converted to millions. Opening reserves taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year comparative). Prior year development taken from Note 12 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). The report does not quantify the PYD split by line of business; LOB directional movements for Property (release) and Cyber (strengthening) are inferred from narrative. No specific named catastrophe events or quantified LOB-level prior year impacts were provided.
